verdict.rationale: Synctera documents domestic wires over Fedwire as part of its v2 API, with a dedicated guide describing real-time settlement. That covers only one of the three fast rails the story asks for. The real-time Internal Transfer API moves money only between two Synctera accounts, so it is not RTP or FedNow. Missing for 10: any evidence of RTP origination/receipt, any evidence of FedNow origination/receipt, documented per-rail capability comparison, explicit confirmation of inbound wire receipt alongside origination.
